hoaxes.title: Anthropic's new Ultra plan includes a monthly printed book of your Claude conversations
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Anthropic renamed its $200 Max 20x plan to Ultra and dropped the five-hour limit for verified accounts.

hoaxes.title: Clayface ticket buyers get a tub of modelling clay to sculpt their own villain
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Clayface took an estimated $10.2 million in its second weekend, for a 10-day total of $44 million.

hoaxes.title: Every boxed copy of GTA VI will include a free 210 GB memory card
hoaxes.truth: Made up. GTA VI launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox; its download size has been reported at 210 GB.

hoaxes.title: Apple's HomeView will sell a $49 add-on that projects the weather onto your ceiling
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Apple's HomeView ships November 13 at $299 and supports up to six users.
